jobs.title: VP, Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Rewind is a service that protects the critical data that powers businesses of all sizes. Our focus is on backing up data that lives in the cloud - in apps like Jira, GitHub, Confluence and Shopify. We are backed by Insight Partners, Inovia, Bessemer and Atlassian Ventures and are proud to be recognized as one of Canada's 50 fastest growing technology companies (2023 Deloitte Fast 50). We invite you to read our startup story to learn where we came from and where we’re going.

Read about our mission, story and values here.
To find out more about our perks, click here.
Some of our Blogs might help you get a better understanding of what we do here. You can find them all here.

Thriving at Rewind:

We embrace the fast-paced, ever-changing nature of startup life. If you love working with speed, agility, and creativity, you’ll feel right at home here. Here's what it takes to succeed with us:

  • Team-First Mentality: We put teamwork at the core of everything we do, believing that we are better when we are together. Success is shared, and when the team wins, we all win.

  • Performance-Driven Mindset: We are proactive, goal-oriented, and focused on delivering tangible, high-quality results. We go beyond meeting expectations - we aim to exceed them.

  • Flexible Work-Life Approach: We encourage balance and understand the need to recharge. While we stay agile for urgent needs, we make sure there's time to recover and enjoy life.

  • Customer Centricity: Our commitment to customers shapes everything we do. We listen, build relationships, and innovate - from our dedicated customer support team to our engineers, everyone at our company is focused on solving problems that matter most to our users.

  • Taking Initiative: We value ownership and proactive problem-solving. We encourage team members to think creatively, take ownership, and lead improvements. Your ideas and actions drive our success.

  • We Make Time for Fun: We work hard and make time to enjoy the journey. It’s not just about hitting milestones—it’s about making the experience rewarding along the way.

Rewind protects the data businesses run on - and technology is how we deliver on that promise. As VP, Engineering, you'll own the full R&D function: engineering, cloud infrastructure, security, and customer support - reporting directly to the CEO with no layers in between. You'll be the company's most senior technical voice, a genuine strategic partner to the executive team, and the person who sets the bar for how we build, scale, and operate.

The context matters: we're at a pivotal point in our growth, moving deeper into enterprise - and we need a leader who has done this transition before. You've taken a B2B SaaS product through the enterprise-readiness inflection: you know what that demands architecturally, operationally, and organizationally, and you know the difference between scaling for volume and scaling for trust. You've also led technical teams through real transformation - AI adoption, culture resets, periods of change - and you've left those teams with more momentum and capability than you found them.

We run lean, we move fast, and we expect our leaders to be close to the work. If you've built high-performing R&D functions in focused, high-growth environments and driven meaningful outcomes with compact teams, that's the experience that travels here.

What you'll do

Set and execute the technology vision

  • Define Rewind's engineering and infrastructure vision and strategy — where we're going architecturally, how we build for scale and reliability, and how we stay ahead of the market

  • Develop and execute a unified technology vision that positions Rewind as the market leader in SaaS backup and recovery

  • Collaborate with the executive team to align technology initiatives with company goals, ensuring revenue growth, profitability, and customer satisfaction

  • Bring together engineering, cloud ops, trust and security, and support under a unified approach that balances speed with quality and cost efficiency

  • Own the technology budget, making ROI-based decisions on tooling, vendors, and infrastructure investment

  • Represent engineering in board and investor conversations, contributing to annual planning, budgeting, and strategic prioritization

Lead the enterprise transition

  • Own Rewind's enterprise-readiness roadmap — SSO, advanced permissions, audit logging, compliance certifications, enterprise SLAs, and the operational maturity that comes with serving larger customers at higher stakes

  • Define what "enterprise-grade" means at every layer of the product and the business, working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to deliver against it

  • Build the architecture, security posture, and processes that earn and sustain enterprise trust at scale — and evolve them as customer requirements grow

Build and lead high-performing teams

  • Lead and grow a multidisciplinary team of engineers, cloud operations specialists, and support professionals

  • Set the culture: high accountability, continuous learning, direct feedback, and genuine collaboration across functions

  • You've inherited teams that needed a reset — you know how to rebuild trust, restore momentum, and create the conditions where great engineering happens

  • Recruit and retain top technical talent, and build an environment where high performers want to stay and grow

Drive AI-powered engineering

  • Champion the adoption of AI across the engineering org — in how your teams write code, review architecture, debug faster, and reduce toil

  • Lead Rewind's internal AI transformation: you've done this before with a dev team, you have a point of view on how to do it well, and you set the example from the top

  • Push for AI-native workflows that meaningfully lift output quality and velocity

Connect technology to the customer

  • Oversee the customer support organization: monitoring quality standards, metrics (CSAT, first response time, resolution rate), and ensuring customers have timely, effective resolution of issues

  • Partner with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to ensure what we build maps to real customer needs

  • Ensure that engineering, support, sales, and product teams close the feedback loop between customer-reported issues and product improvements, reducing support burden through proactive quality and self-serve tooling

What you'll bring

  • 15+ years in technology leadership, with at least 8 years at a senior level owning engineering and/or technical operations

  • Proven track record scaling engineering and support teams in a high-growth SaaS environment

  • Deep fluency in modern software development, cloud infrastructure, and SaaS business models

  • Strong security and compliance experience — you understand what it takes to protect customer data at scale

  • You're a confident, direct communicator who can align technical and non-technical stakeholders without losing precision

  • You actively use AI tools in your own work and have a track record of pushing your teams to do the same — AI fluency isn't something you're working toward, it's already how you operate

  • High agency: you don't wait to be asked, you move with conviction, and you hold yourself and your teams to account

  • Demonstrated experience leading a B2B SaaS company through an enterprise-readiness transition — you've navigated the technical, operational, and organizational complexity of moving upmarket, and you've done it in a product where trust and compliance are core to the value proposition, not afterthoughts

  • Proven ability to lead and rebuild technical teams through change — you raise the performance bar while earning trust, and you know that culture and engineering quality are inseparable

  • Experience participating in board and investor meetings, annual planning, and executive-level budgeting and prioritization

Nice to have

  • Experience in data protection, backup/recovery, or cybersecurity SaaS

  • Familiarity with ITIL or support operations frameworks

  • Experience with agile at scale across distributed teams

Location

Remote-friendly (Canada), with a strong preference for candidates based in Ontario for easier collaboration and occasional in-person meetings at our Ottawa HQ.

Compensation Philosophy
The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

In some cases, we’re open to hiring at a higher level for the right person and are committed to paying competitively and fairly.

If your experience is closer to an earlier career stage, we may still consider your application. In that case, we would evaluate the role at a different level within our levelling framework.

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at Rewind.

Why join Rewind

At Rewind, you’ll help shape the future of data protection for thousands of businesses. We’re performance-driven, innovative, and not afraid to challenge what’s possible. You’ll join a team that values trust, accountability, and respect for people’s time — and encourages every employee to experiment, think critically, and grow.

We support innovation through experimentation — including smart use of AI tools — and believe the best ideas come from those who aren’t afraid to push boundaries.

How Rewind Will Support You
We know that enjoying the journey is just as important as reaching our goals. We work hard to create a positive, inclusive environment where fun and laughter are part of our everyday routine. We also offer a variety of benefits to support your success both at work and in your personal life which includes but is not limited to: 

  • Flexible work hours

  • Employee stock options

  • Health benefits

  • 3 weeks vacation

  • 7 life leave days

  • 2 Level Up days for professional development

  • 1 volunteer day

  • Summer Fridays and office closed during the holiday break in December

  • Paid parental leave

  • $2000/year wellness/home office allowance

  • $5000/year professional development allowance

Rewind is committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. We value how each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply.

AI Usage

Our recruitment process may include the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools to help manage and review applications efficiently. These tools assist our team, but hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.

The Senior Technical Support Engineer (T3) is the highest tier of our support organization, serving as a bridge between customer support and engineering. You will own the most complex, ambiguous technical escalations that our T1 and T2 teams cannot resolve - including issues that previously required involvement from the Engineering Run Team.

The Role

As a Senior Technical Support Engineer, you will serve as the final escalation point within the support organization. You bring a software development background and deep technical instincts to diagnose root causes, reproduce edge cases, write or read code to understand issues at depth, and work directly with the Engineering team to drive resolution. This is not a traditional support role - you will spend a significant portion of your time doing technical investigation work that sits at the boundary of support and engineering.

This role requires participation on a on-call rotation including weekends and holidays.

What You'll Do

  • Own the most complex technical escalations from T1 and T2, serving as the final line of defense.

  • Investigate and reproduce customer-reported bugs, data inconsistencies, and integration failures across Rewind's supported platforms (Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Shopify, QuickBooks Online, and more)

  • Read and write code (primarily in the context of debugging and scripting) to diagnose issues, test hypotheses, and validate fixes

  • Work directly with Engineering to clearly articulate bugs, provide reproducible test cases, and track fixes through to resolution

  • Manage and resolve issues in customer environments involving API integrations, OAuth configurations, webhook failures, and platform-level permissions

  • Handle data restoration requests and complex recovery scenarios requiring deep knowledge of Rewind's backup architecture

  • Own enterprise customer onboarding when required, including installation, deployment, and education, ensuring the customer is fully set up for success

  • Help build and maintain the internal knowledge base for complex issue patterns, enabling T1/T2 to self-serve future resolutions

  • Participate in on-call rotations for P1 incidents affecting enterprise customers

  • Identify recurring escalation patterns and proactively surface product improvement opportunities to Engineering and Product

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical support, solutions engineering, or software development role

  • Computer Science degree or equivalent practical experience (you can read and write code)

  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Ruby, JavaScript, or similar)

  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and modern SaaS integration patterns

  • Experience with cloud platforms and SaaS ecosystems (Atlassian, GitHub, Shopify, or similar)

  • AWS - CloudWatch for logs, OpenSearch/Kibana for search infrastructure, SQS/SNS for async processing

  • Ability to read logs, inspect API responses, and debug issues at the network and application layers

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication - you can explain a complex technical root cause to a non-technical customer and to an engineer on the same day

  • Comfort working independently in ambiguous, high-stakes situations with limited documentation

Nice to Have

  • Experience with backup, recovery, or data resilience products

  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or Atlassian platform administration

  • Experience with PostgreSQL and DynamoDB

  • Prior experience in a SaaS company at a similar scale (Series B / growth stage)

  • Experience working with enterprise customers and navigating complex account relationships

Location

There is a strong preference for candidates based in Ontario for easier collaboration.

Compensation Philosophy
The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

In some cases, we’re open to hiring at a higher level for the right person and are committed to paying competitively and fairly.

If your experience is closer to an earlier career stage, we may still consider your application. In that case, we would evaluate the role at a different level within our levelling framework.

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at Rewind.

Why join Rewind

At Rewind, you’ll help shape the future of data protection for thousands of businesses. We’re performance-driven, innovative, and not afraid to challenge what’s possible. You’ll join a team that values trust, accountability, and respect for people’s time — and encourages every employee to experiment, think critically, and grow.

We support innovation through experimentation — including smart use of AI tools — and believe the best ideas come from those who aren’t afraid to push boundaries.

How Rewind Will Support You
We know that enjoying the journey is just as important as reaching our goals. We work hard to create a positive, inclusive environment where fun and laughter are part of our everyday routine. We also offer a variety of benefits to support your success both at work and in your personal life which includes but is not limited to: 

  • Flexible work hours

  • Employee stock options

  • Health benefits

  • 3 weeks vacation

  • 7 life leave days

  • 2 Level Up days for professional development

  • 1 volunteer day

  • Summer Fridays and office closed during the holiday break in December

  • Paid parental leave

  • $2000/year wellness/home office allowance

  • $5000/year professional development allowance

Rewind is committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. We value how each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply.

You’ll join a team that values trust, accountability, and respect for people’s time — and encourages every employee to experiment, think critically, and grow.

We support innovation through experimentation — including smart use of AI tools — and believe the best ideas come from those who aren’t afraid to push boundaries.




How Rewind Will Support You
We know that enjoying the journey is just as important as reaching our goals. We work hard to create a positive, inclusive environment where fun and laughter are part of our everyday routine. We also offer a variety of benefits to support your success both at work and in your personal life which includes but is not limited to: 

 - Flexible work hours

 - Employee stock options

 - Health benefits

 - 3 weeks vacation

 - 7 life leave days

 - 2 Level Up days for professional development

 - 1 volunteer day

 - Summer Fridays and office closed during the holiday break in December

 - Paid parental leave

 - $2000/year wellness/home office allowance

 - $5000/year professional development allowance

Rewind is committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. We value how each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply.

Our recruitment process may include the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools to help manage and review applications efficiently. These tools assist our team, but hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Rewind is a service that protects the critical data that powers businesses of all sizes. Our focus is on backing up data that lives in the cloud - in apps like Jira, GitHub, Confluence and Shopify. We are backed by Insight Partners, Inovia, Bessemer and Atlassian Ventures and are proud to be recognized as one of Canada's 50 fastest growing technology companies (2023 Deloitte Fast 50). We invite you to read our startup story to learn where we came from and where we’re going.

Read about our mission, story and values here.
To find out more about our perks, click here.
Some of our Blogs might help you get a better understanding of what we do here. You can find them all here.

Thriving at Rewind:

We embrace the fast-paced, ever-changing nature of startup life. If you love working with speed, agility, and creativity, you’ll feel right at home here. Here's what it takes to succeed with us:

  • Team-First Mentality: We put teamwork at the core of everything we do, believing that we are better when we are together. Success is shared, and when the team wins, we all win.

  • Performance-Driven Mindset: We are proactive, goal-oriented, and focused on delivering tangible, high-quality results. We go beyond meeting expectations - we aim to exceed them.

  • Flexible Work-Life Approach: We encourage balance and understand the need to recharge. While we stay agile for urgent needs, we make sure there's time to recover and enjoy life.

  • Customer Centricity: Our commitment to customers shapes everything we do. We listen, build relationships, and innovate - from our dedicated customer support team to our engineers, everyone at our company is focused on solving problems that matter most to our users.

  • Taking Initiative: We value ownership and proactive problem-solving. We encourage team members to think creatively, take ownership, and lead improvements. Your ideas and actions drive our success.

  • We Make Time for Fun: We work hard and make time to enjoy the journey. It’s not just about hitting milestones—it’s about making the experience rewarding along the way.

About the role

This role is the steel thread between our product strategy and the sales and marketing work that turns it into results. You'll build our go-to-market strategies and run product launches from plan to launch day, working closely with product managers, partners and sales.

We do most of our product marketing through AI skills and agents that we personally build for ourselves. Research, competitive analysis, launch plans, messaging drafts and sales enablement all start with tools like Claude Code, and you'll work that way too. If you already do, great. If you're strong on product marketing fundamentals and curious about AI, we can teach you the rest.

We're a small team, so you'll own your products end to end and make a lot of your own calls. Nobody expects that on day one. You'll work closely with the team while you ramp up, and you'll have support the whole way.

What you'll do

Launches and go-to-market

  • Plan launches for new products, features and releases, and run the cross-functional plan through to launch.

  • Develop marketing programs for your products with the marketing team, including the activities and budgets for keeping current customers and winning new ones.

  • Work with the demand generation and content team on programs that keep demand coming.

  • Measure how your programs perform, show what's working and what isn't, and report back on what needs to change.

Positioning and messaging

  • Work with product management and marketing communications to develop positioning, messaging and content for our target buyer personas.

  • Explain in plain terms how our products solve our buyers' problems, and back your thinking with market evidence.

  • Represent your products externally through speaking engagements and written work.

Buyer and competitive insight

  • Be the expert on our buyers, including who they are, how they buy and what criteria drive their decisions.

  • Know the competitive landscape: how each competitor positions itself today and where they're heading.

  • Map our buyer's journey, including where buyers get information and who makes which decisions, when and why. Use what you learn to change how we sell and market.

Sales and partner enablement

  • Support our sales channels. Train them on the problems we solve, build internal tools and external collateral, and show them how and when to use each piece.

  • Turn your positioning and messaging into material our marketing, partner and sales teams can put to work.

AI-powered product marketing

  • Use AI tools every day to research markets and competitors, draft and test messaging, and build launch and enablement assets.

  • Build and refine repeatable AI workflows (prompts, templates, agents) that the wider marketing and sales teams can reuse.

  • Other responsibilities aligned with the PMA’s definition of a PMM’s responsibilities.

What you'll bring

  • 4+ years of product marketing experience in B2B, including product launches, positioning and messaging.

  • Sales enablement experience, such as training sellers and building the battlecards and collateral they rely on.

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work, or a clear appetite to learn them fast. AI is a core part of how this role works every day. We weigh PMM fundamentals more heavily than AI expertise, because AI is easier to teach.

  • Experience working with product teams to define product strategy.

  • Comfort working with technical teams and translating technical products into buyer value. A technical background is a plus.

  • Strong quantitative analytical skills, and clear written and spoken communication in positioning, messaging and storytelling.

  • A customer-centric approach, with experience talking directly to customers.

  • Diplomacy with cross-functional partners, including knowing when to push back and when to dive in.

  • Comfort working independently on a small, entrepreneurial team that moves quickly.

  • Strong organization while managing multiple projects and priorities.

Nice to have

  • Experience building AI workflows or automations for a marketing or sales team.

Compensation Philosophy
The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

In some cases, we’re open to hiring at a higher level for the right person and are committed to paying competitively and fairly.

If your experience is closer to an earlier career stage, we may still consider your application. In that case, we would evaluate the role at a different level within our levelling framework.

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at Rewind.
